comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and from doc/manual.md in the same tree, with the control descriptions checked against the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com. The three knobs are all 0 to 1 with a default of 0.5 and the maker gave them no parameter names, so the panel lettering is the only name they have. In HysteresisProcessing::cook the saturation knob sets the saturation magnetisation as 1.5 minus the knob, the drive knob divides it by six times the drive, and the bias knob reaches the loop width as one minus the knob. The module builds a 30Hz DC blocking filter in process() and never calls it, so no DC blocking is applied; the output is the hysteresis output times 4.18.
